summary: This excerpt from a fiction book (Book 14, part 30) is a chat-log style scene in which members of an online group react to Shad's legal trouble. Shad has retained a lawyer and a legal team, and the group discusses starting a PayPal-based defense fund for the costs of filing and related expenses. Gargle found a website for a "Solidarity Committee for the Minneapolis Nine" and looked up its owner, but Shad says they do not know that group. Shad reflects on how close the Group feels, how members help one another, and why Shad has kept some personal life private, before Gargle begins apologizing.
one_line: In a fiction excerpt, an online group rallies to fund Shad's legal defense while Gargle questions a rival defense committee's website.
key_facts: Shad reports having got a lawyer, and ferret responds "Great !"
Shad's lawyer has recruited a whole legal team, per the chat.
DoDec proposes starting a defense fund, noting there are filing fees and that the costs add up fast even if the lawyer is pro bono.
Kadabra suggests PayPal and asks members to DM their details so the fund can get rolling.
Gargle found a site for "The Solidarity Committee for the Minneapolis Nine."
Gargle says the site owner's identity was public on a Whois search, including address and phone number.
Gargle describes the site owner as a kid who had become a full-time organizer building websites and running social media campaigns for progressive causes around the Twin Cities.
Shad says they do not know the Solidarity Committee and that they stopped typing to think.
Shad says the Group cared about the things Shad cared about and had inside jokes nobody else would get.
Freddieb wanted to attend a hackathon in London, and the Group bought him a train ticket because he could not afford it.
When Wrath of Cohen was undergoing chemo and feeling down, the Group had his favorite pizza delivered to his hotel room.
Shad says "We were family" and questions why Shad had always kept parts of life separate.
Gargle apologizes to Shad, writing "Soryr, Shad."
